note: Robinhood Chain (4663) infrastructure: pools, liquidity managers, routers, launchpad factories and bonding-curve/vault contracts. Never a holder, never a deployer. Each entry says how it was identified (2026-10-24, from creation txs and the first transfers of YMB, NUZL, microduck, LONG and Pons tokens).

addresses.label: Uniswap v4 PoolManager
addresses.identifiedBy: 24,009-byte singleton that pays out every v4 swap of YMB/NUZL/LONG tokens and emits Initialize for their pools

addresses.label: Uniswap v4 PositionManager
addresses.identifiedBy: tx.to of the deployer's LP-seeding tx for YMB (multicall 0xac9650d8) and NUZL (modifyLiquidities 0xdd46508f)

addresses.label: Uniswap Universal Router
addresses.identifiedBy: tx.to of early YMB buys, execute() selector 0x3593564c

addresses.label: aggregator router (0xe6cb474f)
addresses.identifiedBy: tx.to of early YMB buys

addresses.label: aggregator router (0xb3938887)
addresses.identifiedBy: tx.to of early NUZL buys

addresses.label: router (0x1dcd4dad)
addresses.identifiedBy: tx.to of an early YMB buy

addresses.label: swap helper (13.6 KB)
addresses.identifiedBy: receives tokens from the PoolManager inside Universal Router swaps (YMB)

addresses.label: WETH (quote currency of NUZL / Pons pools)
addresses.identifiedBy: currency0 of NUZL's v4 pool key and present in Pons creation txs

addresses.label: LONG launchpad factory (proxy)
addresses.identifiedBy: tx.to of the creation tx of LONG tokens VCE, GROKFI (…1e18 vanity addresses)

addresses.label: shared vault of LONG and …aac launchpads (mint recipient)
addresses.identifiedBy: Transfer-from-0x0 recipient of LONG and …aac launchpad tokens

addresses.label: v4 hook used by LONG and …aac launchpads (25.5 KB)
addresses.identifiedBy: emits logs in every LONG and …aac creation tx

addresses.label: LONG pool initializer
addresses.identifiedBy: emits logs in LONG creation txs

addresses.label: launchpad factory for …aac vanity tokens (name not confirmed on-chain: Odyssey or NOXA)
addresses.identifiedBy: tx.to of the creation tx of BEVO, SUNSP (…aac addresses, HoodScan launchpad 'other')

addresses.label: …aac launchpad pool initializer
addresses.identifiedBy: emits logs in …aac creation txs

addresses.label: Pons launcher
addresses.identifiedBy: tx.to of the creation tx of microduck and Pons token YMB(0x207e…)

addresses.label: Pons launcher v2
addresses.identifiedBy: tx.to of the creation tx of Pons token APES

addresses.label: Pons core (24 KB)
addresses.identifiedBy: emits logs in every Pons creation tx

addresses.label: Pons helper
addresses.identifiedBy: emits logs in every Pons creation tx

addresses.label: Lunch.fun launcher
addresses.identifiedBy: tx.to and mint recipient of the creation tx of RICH

addresses.label: launchpad factory (NTEST)
addresses.identifiedBy: tx.to of the creation tx of NTEST

addresses.label: bonding curve (NTEST launchpad)
addresses.identifiedBy: mint recipient of NTEST

addresses.label: zero address
addresses.identifiedBy: burn

addresses.identifiedBy: burn
